theme_strategy: Light Theme for Store (functional, familiar), Soft Tinted Light Theme with Vibrant Accents for WhyAI Sidebar (distinct, intelligent).

rules: Store typography should feel structured and highly readable, mimicking a large e-commerce marketplace.
WhyAI sidebar typography should feel modern, geometric, and 'smart'.
Headings max size text-4xl to text-5xl on desktop.

visual_enhancers.store_cards: Flat white background, subtle border (border-gray-200), hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-200.
visual_enhancers.ai_feature_cards: Rounded-xl, bg-white, shadow-sm, with a delicate 1px gradient-like border effect (ring-1 ring-indigo-50).
visual_enhancers.collapsed_tab: Gradient background (from-indigo-500 to-cyan-400) text-white rounded-l-xl shadow-lg.

component_name.store_header: Header with 'WhyAI Demo Store' wordmark, search bar placeholder, and category navigation.
component_name.product_card: Image, Title, Price, Rating, and an 'AI Powered' badge.
component_name.pdp_layout: Product Detail Page with 2 columns: Image gallery (left) and Product Info / Add to Cart / 'About this item' AI bullets (right).
component_name.why_ai_sidebar: Persistent overlaid panel on the right.
component_name.loading_state: Sequential message loader (e.g., 'Extracting intent...', 'Scanning specs...', 'Generating insights...').
component_name.feature_card: AI generated personalized benefit with confidence badge, 'Tell me more' accordion, and thumbs up/down.
component_name.feedback_toast: Sonner toast triggered on thumbs up/down.

grids.store_home: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 px-4 md:px-8
grids.pdp: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-12 max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 py-8

layouts.shell: Standard e-commerce flow with fixed header. Main content area takes full width.
layouts.sidebar: fixed right-0 top-0 h-screen w-full sm:w-[400px] z-50 flex flex-col

motion.sidebar_toggle: Use framer-motion. Slide in from right (x: '100%' to x: 0) with a spring transition.
motion.collapsed_tab_pulse: Subtle continuous scale pulse (scale 1 to 1.05) or box-shadow pulse to attract attention.
motion.list_stagger: Feature cards inside the sidebar must appear with a staggered fade-up animation.
motion.hover_effects: Product cards lift up slightly on hover. CTA buttons have a slight scale down on active/click.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially orange CTAs and blue links, meet at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio against white background.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus-visible ring (ring-2 ring-indigo-500 ring-offset-2).
accessibility.aria: Add aria-expanded to the sidebar toggle, aria-live to the loading state.

media.images: Product images should have a clean, light or white background to mimic authentic e-commerce catalogs. Use aspect-square object-contain for product listing images.

3d_libraries.instructions: Not required for this project to maintain a clean marketplace feel. Rely on framer-motion for smooth UI transitions.

smartphones.description: Modern smartphones for the e-commerce catalog.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Next.js or React shell with standard e-commerce routing: Home -> Category -> PDP.
Implement the 'WhyAI' sidebar as a fixed, global component that sits above the page content. It should maintain its state (use-case) across route changes.
Mock the 2-layer RAG system using predefined JSON datasets for a few key products.
For the loading state in the sidebar, use a `useEffect` with timeouts to cycle through 3 sequential text messages before displaying the generated feature cards.
The 'Tell me more' should use an accordion or a simple collapsible div.
Use Lucide-react for all icons (thumbs up, thumbs down, chevron, search, cart).
Integrate 'sonner' for toast notifications when user clicks thumbs up/down.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Lucide icons instead.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
